KNZg57.name: KN Zg 57 (Ivory Ring)
KNZg57.findspot: Anetaki plot, Cult Center, Ivory Repository (NW corner of Neopalatial Room 1, Fetish Shrine area)
KNZg57.context: Neopalatial (1700-1450 BC), early Neopalatial pottery in repository
KNZg57.support: Ivory ring of a 'religious scepter' (elephant ivory, outer diam. 13.5-14cm)
KNZg57.transcriptionStatus: NO full sign-by-sign edition published yet; awaiting Kanta (ed.), Anetaki II, forthcoming. Data below = everything securely published in the 2024 overview paper.
KNZg57.signCountTotal: ca. 119 (longest known Linear A inscription; HT123 has 105 incl. numerals)
KNZg57.numerals: NONE on any face — aligns the Ring with libation vessels, not accounting records
KNZg57.metopes: all signs framed in metopes (vertical dividers), like IO Za 2; word-dividers unnecessary
KNZg57.readingDirection: left-to-right (orientation of AB81 KU, AB40 WI, AB60 RA, AB01 TA; rhyton A664 faces right as on PH 8a.3)

A_top.leftHalf: 12 quadruped animals, each in its own metope, all facing left (pure iconography, ritual feasting animals?)
A_top.rightHalf: at least 10 vases, engraved iconographically; several with a syllabogram in ligature emerging from the vase mouth (VAS+PA, VAS+RU etc.); rhyton (A664) and tripod carry NO syllabogram (shape self-identifying, cf. HT31); 6 vases share amphora typology
A_top.signs: 16 whole/partially preserved signs in metopes, space for at least 2 more (>=18 originally); plus 17 other extant signs simple or in ligature

B_bottom.content: six well-preserved sign GROUPS followed by three logograms, each in its own metope: GRA, probably FAR, and OLIV; no accompanying numbers or fractions; many lacunae
B_bottom.note: the six phonetic sign groups are the core unread text — edition pending

C_external.content: at least nine groups of signs and five logograms for different types of textiles (differing by number of fringes); one textile sign ligatured with AB77 (KA)
C_external.damage: at least 40% of Face C surface lost

D_internal.content: extremely damaged; ca. nine signs for animal hide (AB180) in metopes, none entirely preserved; one trace ligatured with the hide ideogram, restorable as KA (AB77), QE (AB78) or KO (AB70); best parallel: Phaistos Linear A tablets

KNZg57.interpretation: iconography + writing integrated into one 'message' (unique for Linear A): record of elements for a ritual feasting ceremony — animals, vessels, textiles, hides; possibly mnemonic/prescriptive like Hittite ritual records; counterpart attested in a Linear A tablet (per authors, final publication pending)
KNZg57.source: Kanta, Nakassis, Palaima, Perna 2024, 'An archaeological and epigraphical overview of some inscriptions found in the Cult Center of the city of Knossos (Anetaki plot)', KO-RO-NO-WE-SA (Ariadne Supplement Series 5), Rethymno, 27-43. DOI 10.26248/ariadne.vi.1841

KNZg58.name: KN Zg 58 (Ivory handle of the scepter)
KNZg58.findspot: same repository and layer as KN Zg 57
KNZg58.support: Ivory handle, quadrangular section, c. 13cm long; signs 0.5-0.9cm (smaller than Ring)
KNZg58.transcriptionStatus: NO full sign-by-sign edition published yet; see KNZg57.
KNZg58.type: ACCOUNTING text (numerals + fractional signs) — 'first Linear A economic document coming from a cult building'
KNZg58.scribalHand: different incisor than the Ring: AB08 (A) linearized vs calligraphic; AB77 (KA) internal stroke orientation differs; A+KA ligature stacked A-above-KA on Ring but A-below-KA on handle

faces.alpha: two probable vases, each ligatured with a phonetic sign, followed by a sign for TEN; then a probable NEW sign in the Linear A repertory; then *180 and *181 — both otherwise attested in Cretan Hieroglyphic (very rare; proves their use in Linear A)
faces.beta: right end: sequence of four signs (first doubtful, damaged); left half: likely animal-hide sign (recalls Phaistos tablets and Face D of the Ring)
faces.gamma: signs for a boar and probably a pig, WITHOUT numerals
faces.delta: two vases with a ligatured sign above, followed by units and FRACTIONS: six different fraction signs recorded in sequence

KNZg58.fractionSequence: six different fraction signs in one sequence -> first direct evidence for the RELATIVE ordering of Linear A fraction values, partly differing from previous proposals (cf. Corazza, Ferrara, Montecchi, Tamburini, Valerio 2021, JAS 125)
KNZg58.source: Kanta, Nakassis, Palaima, Perna 2024 (see KNZg57), esp. p. 40-42
